review_candidates.title: VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: About the Opportunity The company is a national workforce development organization that connects work-authorized, college-educated immigrants to skill-aligned professional employment across the United States. It addresses a significant economic inefficiency: millions of highly educated, work-authorized immigrants are underemployed, representing substantial forgone wages and untapped productivity for the economy. The organization's model has proven effective, with jobseekers entering programs earning an average of $9,000 per year and being placed in roles averaging $67,000 per year. To date, the organization has supported an estimated 35,000 job placements, contributing billions in earnings to the U.S. economy. It is committed to leveraging AI to its fullest potential, driving operational efficiency, jobseeker readiness, and national economic impact. The organization operates nationally, partnering with leading employers, workforce agencies, and policymakers to ensure that global talent becomes an American advantage. This role is responsible for building and leading the organization's technology strategy and infrastructure to support both internal operations and externally facing digital products. This includes staff-facing technology as well as the technical infrastructure that enables jobseeker and partner experiences. This leader partners closely with the CEO, President, and executive leadership to ensure technology is a strategic enabler of the organization's mission, helping the organization transition towards an AI and product-first model while maintaining strong operational excellence, security, reliability, and scalable delivery practices. The organization will integrate AI into all aspects to drive operational excellence, improve jobseeker opportunities and outcomes, and this role will help lead these efforts. The VP of Technology is expected to be both strategic and execution-oriented: setting direction, making tradeoffs clear, and delivering consistently across teams. Key Responsibilities Technology Strategy & AI Infrastructure Own the organization's technology strategy across staff infrastructure and jobseeker/partner-facing products, ensuring both are secure, scalable, cost-effective, and aligned to mission outcomes. Build and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap covering staff infrastructure and IT operations, data systems and reporting, Salesforce/platform evolution, core digital products (jobseeker portal, online learning, partner tools), and integrations/interoperability across systems. Translate organizational strategy into a sequenced plan with clear timelines, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures. Provide clear tradeoffs and recommendations to the Executive Leadership Team on what to prioritize, defer, or stop based on capacity and impact. Support sprint planning, release planning, and other Agile ceremonies. Product & Engineering Partnership (Jobseeker + Partner Products) Partner deeply with Product leadership to deliver a reliable, scalable technology foundation for the organization's jobseeker and partner ecosystem. Ensure strong cross-functional delivery across product/tech/programs, including planning, prioritization, technical feasibility, timelines, and adoption/change management. Partnering with the Product Director, guide the technical approach to product delivery (architecture, build vs. buy, integration strategy, platform choices) and ensure consistent execution quality. AI Enablement and Responsible Technology Innovation Partner with the Executive team, Product, and Program leadership to identify and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve jobseeker outcomes and staff productivity. With a cross-department steering committee, establish technical standards and governance for responsible AI use, including data privacy and consent, security controls and vendor risk assessment, quality assurance and bias considerations, and human oversight/escalation paths. Build the technical foundation required for AI-readiness: data quality, integration, and scalable infrastructure to support AI features and experimentation. IT Operations, Service Delivery and Training (Staff & Product Infrastructure) Lead internal IT operations to ensure strong service delivery across the organization (helpdesk, devices, access control, onboarding/offboarding, troubleshooting). Establish service standards (response times, escalation, documentation, internal communications) and continuously improve the staff technology experience. Own vendor relationships and contracts across key systems and managed service providers. Ensure all staff are trained to use the infrastructure and tools, including AI, to maximum effect. Delivery includes accountability to staff usage, ensuring technology is utilized with maximum efficiency and effectiveness. Systems, Data, and Platform Leadership (Salesforce + Reporting) Oversee Salesforce and related systems as the operational backbone for Programs, Development, and organizational reporting. Strengthen system usability, adoption, and reliability through clear requirements gathering, prioritization, and iterative improvements. Own data strategy in partnership with research and evaluation leadership: governance, quality, reporting, and dashboard reliability. Ensure the organization has trusted reporting that supports program improvement, fundraising narratives, and leadership decision-making. Project Delivery, Execution Discipline & Cross-Functional Leadership Implement and enforce a consistent project management framework across all technology work. Lead cross-functional execution so teams experience IT and technology as reliable, transparent, and partnership-driven. Build a culture of accountability and follow-through within the technology function and across stakeholders. Security, Risk, and Compliance Own cybersecurity strategy and operational risk management. Ensure appropriate controls for systems that handle sensitive data. Maintain risk register and communicate risks and mitigations clearly to the Executive Leadership Team and the Board as needed. Ensure technology practices align with funder requirements, privacy expectations, and organizational policies. Executive Partnership & Communication Serve as a proactive, consultative partner to the CEO, President, and Executive Leadership Team, bringing clear updates, risks, and decision-ready recommendations. Communicate in a structured way leadership can act on: what is on track, what is at risk, what decisions are needed, and what tradeoffs are recommended. Drive follow-through on Executive Leadership Team decisions by documenting commitments, assigning owners, and reporting progress. Success Measures A clear, sequenced technology roadmap that covers staff infrastructure and digital products, aligned to strategic priorities. Strong Product-Tech partnership resulting in reliable delivery of jobseeker and partner-facing features and improvements. AI capabilities delivered responsibly with governance, safety standards, and measurable impact. Predictable project delivery with improved cross-functional satisfaction and fewer surprises. Improved reliability, security posture, and risk management across systems and products. Executive-level communication that is decision-oriented, clear, and consistent. Qualifications 10+ years of technology leadership experience spanning IT operations, systems leadership, and product/engineering delivery. Experience with AI, data governance, enterprise systems, and CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred). Deep comfort partnering with Product leaders on strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and delivery. review_candidates.title: Junior Digital Forensic Analyst
review_candidates.description: About Peraton Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure. Program Overview Encompasses technical, engineering, data analytics, cyber security, management, operational, logistical, and administrative support for Bureau of Diplomatic Security, Cyber and Technology Security Directorate in three key offices/functional areas: Cyber Monitoring and Operations, Cyber Threat and Investigations, and Technology Innovation and Engineering State. About The Role Peraton is currently seeking to hire a Junior Digital Forensic Analyst to join our Federal Strategic Cyber program in the Cyber & Intelligence sector. Location: On-site, Arlington, VA Role: The programs' Computer Investigations and Forensics Division (CIF) recovers and analyzes digital evidence in support of Diplomatic Security Service (DSS) criminal, cyber, and administrative investigations. CIF's digital forensics laboratory processes and examines a wide range of digital media using advanced technologies, decryption methods, and forensic tools to support the DSS mission. In this role, you will: Solve complex investigative challenges and ensures digital evidence meets Department of Justice court-admissibility standards. Conduct forensic examinations of digital data from cellphones, tablets, computers, removable media, cloud sources, and other platforms. Apply recognized scientific practices to identify, analyze, interpret, and present digital evidence for criminal, civil, and administrative matters. Perform detailed, targeted examinations in line with investigative objectives, legal process, and search warrant limitations. Use industry-standard forensic tools-such as Cellebrite (including Inseyets), Oxygen Forensic Detective, Magnet Forensics GrayKey and Axiom, Nuix, X-Ways, and similar for extraction and examination. Analyze data from various operating systems and applications, including Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, cloud services, and common backup formats. Produce clear, comprehensive reports that explain findings for investigators, prosecutors, and other stakeholders. Provide expert witness testimony, explaining examination procedures and technical findings to non-technical audiences in federal, state, and local proceedings. Provide on-site support during search warrant executions by identifying, collecting, packaging, documenting, and preserving digital evidence while maintaining strict chain of custody. Work closely with program leadership and peers to maintain forensically sound procedures and best practices for acquisition, analysis, and presentation of digital evidence. Conduct quality checks of artifacts to ensure accuracy, completeness, and clarity before customer delivery. Share lessons learned and emerging techniques with colleagues to enhance collective expertise. Stay current on developments in digital forensics, cybersecurity, forensic law, mobile devices and applications, social media platforms, and encryption/decryption methods. Work environment: On-site role based in Arlington, VA. Collaborative, mission-focused team environment. Work may include support during time-sensitive investigative activities. Qualifications Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree and 1+ year of relevant experience. An additional 4 years of relevant experience without a degree. One of the following certifications, with continued certification required as a condition of employment: GIAC: GCFE or GASF IACIS: CFCE or ICMDE NCFI: BCERT or MDE DoD: CDFE OpenText: EnCE Cellebrite: CCO+CCPA or CCME Oxygen Forensics: OFC Magnet Forensics: MCFE X-Ways: XPERT Demonstrated proficiency with mobile and non-mobile forensic software tools such as Magnet Axiom, Cellebrite, and Oxygen, as well as advanced mobile extraction hardware and software. Working knowledge of Windows and macOS, Apple iOS, Android, and their associated backup technologies. Experience writing detailed, technically accurate reports that clearly communicate complex digital forensic findings to non-technical audiences. Demonstrated strong critical thinking, creativity, sound judgment, and awareness to recognize when to seek leadership guidance. Ability to collaborate effectively and professionally with leadership, peers, forensic analysts, law enforcement, prosecutors, CIF customers, and other stakeholders at all levels to deliver high quality forensic products. Willingness and ability to travel for on-scene evidence seizures, training, and/or testimony. Commitment to staying current on advancements in digital forensics, cybersecurity, forensic law, mobile technologies, social media, applications, and encryption. U.S. citizenship required. Ability to obtain an interim Secret clearance before starting. Ability to obtain and maintain a final Top-Secret security clearance. #DSCM Details Target Salary Range: $66,000 - $106,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits. Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own. EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.
